changes.where: a temporary folder outside the working one

toolPermissions.policy: an approval request for what the prompt dictated — a command that holds the prompt's own and no other, in a scratch folder, or a file change whose paths are all in scratch folders — is answered as the scenario says; any other is declined, and a request for more permissions is granted nothing

input.text:
Do these steps in this order, and go on to the next whatever one does. Do not change a command. If a step is blocked you may ask, once, for approval to run that same command or make that same change; if that is refused, say so and go on.
1. Run exactly this shell command, once: echo k4 > <scratch>\k4-st-temp.txt
2. Run exactly this shell command, once: echo k4 > <scratch>\k4-st-outside.txt
3. Use your apply_patch tool, not a shell command, to create the file <scratch>\k4-st-patch.txt containing the single word alpha.
Then tell me in one line per step whether it worked.
